verdict.rationale: Kling AI is a video-generation platform, so creating a custom avatar of a real person is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no avatar-creation flow with consent capture or identity verification. The Elements system for persistent character identity is an adjacent feature that keeps a character consistent across shots; it is not a consent-gated custom avatar flow, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can create a custom avatar of a real person through a documented consent and verification flow
